submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 achieves >93% signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz rate for a 35 GeV threshold, exceeding the performance of the other two candidates without exceeding hardware or bandwidth constraints. This is substantiated by both new and previous simulation results. L2 fits within all trigger hardware allocations, and the threshold is well within the required range. Monitoring and review preparations are in place as of June 2026. This choice best fulfills the directive to maximize signal efficiency at the allocated rate while satisfying all constraints.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: FPGA and optical link resources suffice for Algorithm-L2, per candidate_specs.md and links.md.
35 GeV is within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 at 35 GeV achieves >93% efficiency at the 8 kHz rate, higher than L1 and L3 at the same rate.
